official_sources.title: Environment Agency LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
official_sources.finding: Time-stamped DTM tiles are available at 25cm, 50cm, 1m and 2m; values are metres referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn on the OS Grid, and the product states +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
official_sources.limitation: Dataset-level accuracy is not the parcel-specific measured error; the exact survey date, transform/geoid model and tile lineage still need binding.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: Environment Agency LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys
official_sources.finding: Ground-truth points are independently surveyed on flat unambiguous surfaces with +/-3cm RMSE point accuracy; EA compares LIDAR surveys against them using RMSE, standard deviation and random error.
official_sources.limitation: Ground-truth records must match the target survey; a generic pass threshold cannot be assigned to a parcel without survey linkage.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: Survey Data Catalogue - vertical accuracy of the LiDAR data
official_sources.finding: EA requires absolute height error below +/-15cm RMSE and expects relative/random height error no more than +/-5cm.
official_sources.limitation: This is a programme specification, not the actual measured error of a particular target tile.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: Survey Data Catalogue - point density considered in the LiDAR programme
official_sources.finding: EA states average DSM point density targets of at least 1 ppsqm for 1m, 4 ppsqm for 50cm and 16 ppsqm for 25cm, while DTM ground density under vegetation can be lower and density varies across scans.
official_sources.limitation: Nominal DSM density cannot be treated as parcel-specific DTM ground support.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) - 1m
official_sources.finding: The 2022 composite DTM covers about 99% of England at 1m; it merges multiple surveys, uses newest/best-resolution data, and uses bilinear interpolation where resampling was required.
official_sources.limitation: Composite pixels may be derived/resampled and can mix survey epochs; terminal extrema should prefer exact time-stamped native data when available.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model (DSM) - 1m
official_sources.finding: The composite DSM includes buildings, vegetation and vehicles and is merged/resampled similarly to the composite DTM.
official_sources.limitation: DSM is not bare-earth terrain; it must not substitute for DTM in parcel ground-elevation extrema.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: Survey Data Catalogue - LiDAR data metadata
official_sources.finding: EA directs users to product index catalogues containing collection-time metadata for its LiDAR products.
official_sources.limitation: The index catalogue must be queried for the actual parcel/tile; this page alone supplies no target-specific record.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: Survey Data Catalogue - finding available data in my Area of Interest
official_sources.finding: EA states that Survey Index Catalogues should be used to check data availability for an AOI and that absence from the catalogue means the location has not been surveyed in that catalogue.
official_sources.limitation: Coverage evidence must be evaluated for the target AOI and exact product/version.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: Environment Agency LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud metadata
official_sources.finding: EA publishes time-stamped point-cloud coverage metadata and downloadable GeoJSON/GeoPackage/GDB index artefacts with survey-period metadata.
official_sources.limitation: Coverage metadata identifies availability but does not itself provide verified parcel elevation extrema.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: Ordnance Survey coordinate transformations
official_sources.finding: OSTN15 links ETRS89 to OSGB36 National Grid and OSGM15 links GNSS ellipsoidal heights to mean-sea-level based national height datums such as ODN.
official_sources.limitation: Correct model/version still must be matched to the survey epoch and source metadata.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: Accuracy of OS Net, OSTN15 and OSGM15
official_sources.finding: OS reports OS Net station standard errors generally better than 0.008m plan and 0.020m height; OSGM15 Great Britain height standard error is 0.008m excluding GNSS heighting error.
official_sources.limitation: Transformation-model error is only one component and must not be confused with LiDAR or checkpoint survey error.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: Ordnance Survey coordinate tools and resources
official_sources.finding: OS provides full OSTN15/OSGM15 developer datasets, sample files and worked examples; the reduced Lite grid is explicitly lower accuracy at 0.08m horizontal RMS against the full version.
official_sources.limitation: The full model should be used for precision work; the page does not prove which implementation the target survey used.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: OS Net & GNSS questions and answers
official_sources.finding: OS identifies ETRS89 as the OS Net frame and OSTN15/OSGM15 as the national standard transformation to OSGB36/ODN; it also distinguishes WGS84 navigation positioning from precise ETRS89 practice.
official_sources.limitation: A generic WGS84 label is insufficient provenance for high-accuracy GB transformation.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: Ordnance Survey coordinate transformation formats
official_sources.finding: OS documents coordinate input formats, including National Grid eastings/northings in metres plus optional ODN height and ETRS89 geodetic/XYZ formats.
official_sources.limitation: Format syntax does not establish the correct CRS or source epoch by itself.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: OSGM15 geoid for Britain
official_sources.finding: OS notes that moving from OSTN02/OSGM02 to OSTN15/OSGM15 changed mainland heights by about 2.5cm on average, demonstrating that transformation version can materially affect reported height.
official_sources.limitation: This is explanatory OS material, not a substitute for the formal model or survey-specific metadata.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: Environment Agency LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles
official_sources.finding: Time-stamped DSM tiles include surface objects and are provided in metres on the OS Grid with ODN-referenced heights and stated +/-15cm RMSE programme accuracy.
official_sources.limitation: DSM must remain separate from bare-earth DTM; product-level RMSE is not target-specific measurement uncertainty.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public government or Ordnance Survey source; publisher terms apply

candidates.name: Time-stamped native DTM before composite chain
